title: Web Developer Pricing System
audience: Freelance developers who improvise project prices or struggle to protect margin.
coreOutcome: Build a consistent method for scoping, pricing, and explaining project fees.
problem: Pricing from instinct alone makes similar projects produce inconsistent risk and margin.
situation: Each inquiry creates a new pricing decision with incomplete information.
commonFailure: Copying market rates ignores your scope, delivery risk, capacity, and commercial context.
methodology: Connect qualification, scope, risk, capacity, value context, and price communication.
capabilities: Account for scope and delivery risk
Explain a price without apologizing for it
whoItsNotFor: Anyone looking for a universal hourly rate

seo.title: Web Developer Pricing System | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: A practical system for pricing web-development projects with clearer scope and risk.
